description: This file defines the 'Order' class in the package 'com.salesmanager.web.admin.entity.orders'. The class implements Serializable and contains fields representing order details such as ID, order history comment, order status list, date purchased, and embedded delivery and billing information. It includes standard getters and setters for these fields.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents an Order with associated billing, delivery, status, and other related information.
